description: Na₃HfTa(GeO₄)₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.70 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.51-2.68 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.99 Å. Hf is bonded to six O atoms to form HfO₆ octahedra that share corners with six GeO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Hf-O bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.13 Å. Ta is bonded to six O atoms to form TaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six GeO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ta-O bond distances ranging from 1.92-2.07 Å. There are three inequivalent Ge sites. In the first Ge site, Ge is bonded to four O atoms to form GeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent HfO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent TaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 19-42°. There are a spread of Ge-O bond distances ranging from 1.73-1.80 Å. In the second Ge site, Ge is bonded to four O atoms to form GeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent HfO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent TaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 26-41°. There are a spread of Ge-O bond distances ranging from 1.73-1.80 Å. In the third Ge site, Ge is bonded to four O atoms to form GeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent HfO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent TaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 17-40°. There are a spread of Ge-O bond distances ranging from 1.73-1.80 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Hf, and one Ge atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Ta, and one Ge atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ta and one Ge atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Na, one Hf, and one Ge atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Hf, and one Ge atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Ta, and one Ge atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂TaGe trigonal pyramids. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ta, and one Ge atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Hf and one Ge atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Hf, and one Ge atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ta, and one Ge atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Hf, and one Ge atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₃HfGe trigonal bipyramids. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Ta, and one Ge atom.
